heading: Sunday Night
text: Partial clearing after midnight. Lows in the 50s to low 60s, a few mid 60s along Lake Champlain. Calm wind.

heading: Monday
text: Morning sun, then increasing clouds. Chance of a few afternoon showers or thunderstorms, highest chances west of the Greens. Highs in the low to mid 80s, a few upper 80s in the warmest valleys. Wind becoming south at 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Periods of clouds, with a chance of showers or a thunderstorm. Lows from the upper 50s to low 60s, a few mid 60s along Lake Champlain.
